conversation: A: Please marry me Fiona, I want you, I need you, I love you.
B: I'm Sorry Charles, but I can't.
B: Well Charles, I like you, I like you a lot but I don't love you.
A: Oh Fiona, love isn't everything.
B: Oh Charles, you don't understand. For me the love is everything.
A: Do you love another man?
B: Yes Charles, I do, James.
A: He doesn't want you. He is engaged.
A: But Fiona, James isn't a rich man. I can give you everything. What do you want? Clothes, money, travel, a big house?
B: No Charles, I don't want these things, I only want James.
